senses.definition: Any practically minded combination of business administration, management science, operations research, systems engineering, and industrial engineering.
examples: They get the job done, but operations is the area in which they're weakest.

quotes.text: The first US service members to die in the conflict between the US and Iran were killed by a direct Iranian strike on a makeshift operations center at a civilian port in Kuwait on Sunday morning local time, a source familiar with the situation told CNN.
quotes.reference: 2026 March 2, Haley Britzky, “No warning, no siren: Six US service members killed in Iranian strike that hit makeshift operations center in Kuwait”, in CNN, archived from the original on 06 Mar 2026:

senses.definition: The department or interdepartmental team within a company that works on optimizing the company's execution of such things.
examples: She works in operations, and her job involves data analysis and business intelligence.
The operations center was pregnant with dread.
